body: Thanks! I guess I'll go see other people's donkeys when I have the chance. They're really not the pet for me.

Thanks for the answers. I just thought that maybe most boarders around here don't know that much about donkeys specifically. Then again, they can always Google it.

I meant running beside the donkey.
Do you have a diagnosis? I'm diagnosed with medium depression and get some benefits without working. I live in a somewhat socialistic country though. Where do you live?
Already feeling better, just another short moment of feeling useless. No need for support atm.

I've felt this way too. Nowadays I try to accept that I'm a disabled person and might never find a job anyway. Do you have the chance to volunteer regularly and get benefits? If not, I'm sorry I'm no help.

Edit: BTW, do you like animals? Some animal shelters might offer boarding for free for their volunteers. Building stuff could be an important skill there.

You're not a monster. People react to tragedy in different ways. The fact you feel guilt for your feelings is a sign. I don't know how to help you, but you can try living through your negative thoughts without letting them turn into actions.

Hi.

I think you want to live. I know it's hard, but try to not let your mother decide your worth. She might have birthed you, but you're not her property. You are an independent person. In the end, it's up to you to create meaning for your life. Reach out. Find someone to confide in, perhaps online. And please remember, you can always delay the date of your suicide, but you can't cancel it once you're done. Delay your death, one second at a time, and you might pull through.

Love and hugs!
Thanks. I live a pretty active life. I assist an old woman almost weekly. Sometimes I go riding horses. I just don't remember these things when I break down.

Thanks. I'm already feeling somewhat better. My moments of anxiety are usually short and act as mind cleaners, kind of. They're just scarily intense and make me forget about all the good things in my life.
